question: Is the Baseus Blade H1 power bank worth buying? Where's the best place to buy it?
query: Baseus Blade H1 power bank review price buy 2026

rec.answer:
**Yes—if you want a flat, laptop-capable power bank, the Baseus Blade H1 is worth considering, especially around $40–$55. At the official $89.99 price, it’s a less compelling buy.**

### Why it’s worth buying
- **Up to 100W USB-C output:** useful for compatible USB-C laptops, not just phones and tablets.
- **20,000mAh capacity:** a useful reserve for travel and working away from outlets.
- **Bag-friendly shape:** its roughly 0.7-inch-thick, flat design fits a laptop compartment better than many block-shaped power banks.
- **Useful extras:** digital display, four ports, and an included 100W USB-C cable. Baseus also advertises 60W input and pass-through charging. citeturn0search0turn0search2

**The catches:** it weighs about a pound, so “slim” doesn’t mean light or pocketable. Power is shared when multiple ports are used, so don’t expect the full 100W to your laptop while charging other devices. If you only need phone charging, a smaller, lower-output pack is likely more practical. citeturn0search2turn0search5

### Where to buy
**Assuming you’re shopping in the US:**

| Option | Price shown in the supplied results | Recommendation |
|---|---:|---|
| **Amazon, via the H1 deal listing on Slickdeals** | **About $39.50**, posted October 17, 2026 | Best reported H1 deal—but check whether it’s still available. |
| **Baseus official store** | **$89.99**, listed in stock | Straightforward direct purchase; advertises a 24-month warranty and free shipping over $20. |

The Amazon H1 deal is documented on [Slickdeals](https://slickdeals.net/f/20172525-baseus-blade-h1-20000mah-4-port-up-to-100w-slim-power-bank-w-usb-c-cable-39-50-free-s-h). Other reports put the broader Blade model around $49–$54, but those headlines don’t consistently identify it as the **H1**, so check the exact model, seller, and final checkout price. These are dated deal reports, not confirmation of a live offer. citeturn0search12turn0search2turn0search11

**My recommendation:** check the Amazon H1 deal first and buy around **$40–$55** from a reputable seller. If it’s only available at **$89.99 [direct from Baseus](https://www.baseus.com/products/blade-h1-digital-display-power-bank-20000mah-100w)**, I’d wait for a sale unless the flat shape is particularly important to you. citeturn0search0
